# FC-04 multi-selection editing: chosen internal port design

Status: design selected by user on 2026-10-29; P31 control review and P32 acceptance remain separate. Subject: `6bcf2d4bbf3314e5252951190c3c475403f52665`. Preserve D06-B, D07 functional evidence and the independent OOM finding.

## Interface and lifetime

The user chose an internal typed Runtime-owned port. Add `runtime/composition/include/canvas/runtime/internal/multi_selection_port.hpp` containing immutable projection, displayed stamp, typed request and typed receipt. `RuntimeComposition` owns the implementation; `CanvasEditingRuntime` owns selection, applicability, semantic plan and D07 History. The port is a borrowed, optional, owner-thread-only capability, bound by the host after composition opens and invalidated before shutdown, target replacement or controller destruction. Closed/wrong-thread/missing/allocation-failed is explicitly unavailable. Never expose mutable Runtime internals, canonical stores, or host-constructed Operations to Debug UI.

The existing Windows and Web hosts construct `DebugController` from the same source tree and statically link `canvas_debug_ui`. Extend the internal C++ `DebugControllerContext` with an optional port; both hosts bind the same composition-owned implementation, and all Debug UI, hosts and in-tree C++ consumers must be rebuilt together. The context/port are **not** a new stable binary interface and no compatibility with prebuilt C++ consumers is claimed. ADR-0022 defines the stable product ABI as C ABI. This decision does not add or change any exported Runtime C ABI, RuntimeFacade virtual method, `SelectionSummary`, `CanvasControlRequest`, `CanvasControlReceipt`, FieldId, Operation, registry, or wire field. Header self-containment, module dependency, actual host rebuild and unchanged C ABI manifest are blocking tests. If an independently supported prebuilt Debug UI C++ ABI is identified, stop with AUTHORITY_CONFLICT before altering it.

## Read, submit, and publish

The immutable projection includes target/runtime-lifetime identity, selection revision, semantic/document generation, scene generation/revision, normalized root IDs, and per property: eligible/total, typed per-root semantic exclusions, Uniform/Mixed independently from Partial, and authoritative value only if coherent and known. Query/provider failure, lifecycle failure and unknown are Unavailable, not Unsupported. Snapshot capture compares identity around the port read. Displayed stamps must remain bound to the explicit eligible cohort the user confirms.

The typed request identifies client/request, target lifetime, displayed stamp, property FieldId, existing PropertyValue and confirmed root IDs. Add an internal work variant to the *existing* bounded `CanvasControlService` queue, retaining its single owner pump, deadline, duplicate, capacity, target-destruction and receipt semantics. Do not serialize the request in generic receipt detail or overload unrelated CanvasControl fields. Capture the displayed token before enqueue; enqueue and owner dequeue recheck target, selection, document/semantic and scene publication identities. A changed token rejects without mutation or requires a visibly refreshed projection and renewed confirmation. Do not read mutable owner state on an unauthorized producer thread. The exact internal binding must uphold `CanvasControlService`'s locking/owner-thread rules and be tested at both boundaries.

The Interaction owner recomputes applicability and verifies all eligible roots, lock, permission, preimages and payload. It builds existing typed operations; multiple Operations use D07 begin/prepare/commit and abort, reserving Scene, History and typed-outcome storage before publication. Rejecting precommit leaves Document, Scene, History cursor and redo branch unchanged. Never commit each target separately. The owner constructs typed changed/skipped root IDs and reasons from the plan; receipt keyed by request ID is bounded and reports eviction/expiry/duplicate/close truthfully. Undo restores captured preimages even if selection changes; Redo uses fresh operation IDs. UI never synthesizes success.

## Eight existing property rows

Use the frozen Field Registry V1 and existing PropertyValue only: visible 1, locked 2, opacity 3, blend 4, fill 0x100, stroke 0x101, connector start 0x200, connector end 0x201. Read explicit value or its frozen absent-equals-default; never coerce text/brush/fill/stroke semantics. Applicability, invalid value, default elision and true preimages are independently checked for each kind. BlendMode currently only declares Normal; do not invent values. A row that has no real read/write/undo path is unavailable and blocks phase closure if required.

## Binding and verification

`implementation-context.json` and `source-lock.json` bind the exact existing files and new helper names; `test-matrix.json` preserves all MSE-01..27 and the inherited 14/160/30/46/2 suites. The v0.2 source delta and MSE-25 Escape/IME and MSE-27 generation cases are retained. Keep existing negative tests for unsupported single-root controls and revise only assertions superseded by supported multi-root behavior.

Tests must execute real Runtime, service and Debug UI paths and independently assert projection, eligible/total and exclusions, unknown/unavailable, typed transport, stale display-to-queue and queue-to-dequeue, zero-mutation rejection, reservations, outcomes, history, lifecycle, one-intent/one-Undo, independent commands/two-Undo, Windows and actual Chrome/WASM. Exact MSE IDs, tests and raw observations are NOT_RUN until executed; the matrix is an acceptance target, not proof of implementation. Known Protobuf/Abseil OOM remains a blocker for overall D07 release and is not waived.
